description: This Java class implements the <request-parameters-to-list> element for the OFBiz MiniLang framework, converting request parameters into a list within a method operation.

classes.name: RequestParametersToList
classes.description: A method operation class that converts request parameters into a list and stores it in the environment map.

classes.name: RequestParametersToListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RequestParametersToList.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Corrects deprecated attribute 'list-name' to 'list' in the XML element during transition.

methods.name: RequestParametersToList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves request parameter values and adds them to a list in the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the element.
